metadata.name: pixicons-icon
metadata.description: Displays pixel icons from the Pixicons library using the official Pixicons kit.
features: Renders Pixicons icons automatically using the official pixicons.js kit
Supports multiple styles (pixel, rounded, blob, liquid, liquid-blob, retro, stitch, knit, dots) and variants (regular, fill)
Supports states (hover, active) for variant, style, icon, color and size
Customizable size and color inheriting surrounding text color by default
Accessible with configurable label or aria-hidden

properties.name: icon
properties.description: The name of the Pixicons icon (e.g. 'heart', 'arrow-right'). Supports states.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: The icon variant ('regular' or 'fill'). Supports states.

properties.name: style
properties.description: The visual pixel style (pixel, rounded, blob, liquid, liquid-blob, retro, stitch, knit, dots). Supports states.

properties.name: accessibleLabel
properties.description: Accessible label for screen readers. When set, assigns role='img' and aria-label; when empty, sets aria-hidden='true'.

properties.name: size
properties.description: The font-size applied to the icon (e.g. '24px', '1.5rem'). Supports states and breakpoints.

properties.name: color
properties.description: The color applied to the icon. If empty, inherits the surrounding text color. Supports states and breakpoints.

specifications: Loads https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pixiconsio@latest/pixicons.js once into the document head on mount.
Renders an inline-flex root <span> (or <a> when a link is set) containing an <i> element turned into SVG by Pixicons kit.
The <i> classes are: 'px', 'px-' + icon name (lowercased, trimmed), 'px-' + style, 'px-' + variant.

The <i> element is never re-keyed on state changes: only its classes change. After mount and after every re-render (state change, link added or removed, root tag change), the component toggles a helper class on the <i> parent so the kit's MutationObserver rescans and re-renders the icon, including inside the WeWeb editor and preview where the kit ignores nodes created from another window.
Supports native link configuration (options.linkable: true). When a link is set, renders as a link tag with proper SPA or external navigation.
Supports states: true on variant, style, icon, size and color.
Size is applied as font-size on the root; color is applied as color on the root.
